certificate.arithmetic: Exact rational interval arithmetic, outward-rounded after each operation at denominator 10^40.
certificate.algebraic_identity_used: Four-bounce words have identity linear part and translations A*(-cos(18deg),sin(18deg)) and A*(sin(36deg),cos(36deg)); A=(5+3sqrt(5))/2. Endpoint and junction balance follow exactly from these identities.
certificate.scope: Certifies strict polygon itinerary inequalities on a two-dimensional positive-width box, and excludes intermediate junction visits. It is not a certification of the maximal admissible-region area.

scope: Free 120-degree junctions; ordinary specular reflections; one direct edge. The slider is an exact affine continuation of corresponding path vertices, on a fixed-itinerary chamber. Negative searches are bounded and are not global nonexistence proofs.
